jobs: Rebuild this in a medieval Persian style: warm sand-coloured fired brick and smooth plaster, pointed arches and a deep iwan portal framed in turquoise and cobalt glazed tilework with geometric patterns, flat roofs behind low crenellated parapets, small turquoise-tiled domes. No timber framing, no pitched northern roof. Make it a village house: a small single-storey home with a little courtyard or porch.

Rebuild this in a medieval Persian style: warm sand-coloured fired brick and smooth plaster, pointed arches and a deep iwan portal framed in turquoise and cobalt glazed tilework with geometric patterns, flat roofs behind low crenellated parapets, small turquoise-tiled domes. No timber framing, no pitched northern roof. Make it the Town Center: the largest civic building of the town, with a grand entrance, a tall central element visible from far away, and a small courtyard. Give it a tall wind-catcher tower and a large dome.

No timber framing, no pitched northern roof. Make it a barracks: a long training hall with a walled practice yard at the front corner, racks of spears and shields.

Rebuild this in an Inca style from the Andes: walls of grey granite blocks fitted tightly without mortar, trapezoidal doorways and niches, buildings on stone terraces, steep roofs of thick golden ichu-grass thatch on timber, woven textile banners in bright stepped geometric patterns. No timber framing, no European stonework, no arches. Make it a village house: a small single-storey home with a little courtyard or porch.
